rows.statement: FSD drives almost anywhere requiring minimal intervention

sides.text: When enabled, your vehicle will drive you almost anywhere with your active supervision, requiring minimal intervention.
Tesla Full Self Driving requires human intervention every 13 miles

rows.statement: FSD (Supervised) is 7x safer than a human driver

sides.text: Than a Human Driver When FSD (Supervised) Is Engaged5
Critics argue that Tesla has published misleading safety claims about its Autopilot driver-assistance system, and that Tesla cars are actually less safe with Autopilot activated.

rows.statement: Unsupervised FSD will enable robotaxis and Cybercab

sides.text: With Full Self-Driving (Unsupervised), autonomous driving will be made possible, unlocking our fleet of robotaxis and making Cybercab a reality.

Since 2013, Tesla CEO Elon Musk has repeatedly predicted that the company would achieve fully autonomous driving (SAE Level 5) within one to three years, but as of July 2026, these goals are still to be met.

rows.statement: Over 14 billion miles driven on FSD
Trained on over 100 years of scenarios from a fleet of over six million vehicles

sides.text: Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is trained on what amounts to over 100 years of anonymous real-world driving scenarios from our fleet of over six million vehicles.

rows.statement: Currently enabled FSD features do not make the vehicle autonomous

sides.text: Currently enabled features require active driver supervision and do not make the vehicle autonomous.
Tesla vehicles currently require continuous driver supervision which does not constitute full self-driving capability.

rows.statement: FSD (Supervised) available across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific

sides.text: Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is currently available in select markets across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific with expansion to additional regions expected with future updates.2
FSD (Supervised) began rolling out to major international markets throughout 2025 and 2026.

rows.statement: FSD includes Autopark and Smart Summon

sides.text: Your Tesla vehicle will automatically detect and maneuver into perpendicular and parallel parking spots for you.
adds semi-autonomous navigation on nearly all roads, self-parking, and the ability to summon the car from a parking space
